mapper.insert: insert into br_stock_ledger (material_id, mark_type, biz_type, biz_table, biz_id, biz_no, goods_source_type, goods_source_no, work_no, batch_no, qty, balance, create_time) values (#{materialId}, #{markType}, #{bizType}, #{bizTable}, #{bizId}, #{bizNo}, #{goodsSourceType}, #{goodsSourceNo}, #{workNo}, #{batchNo}, #{qty}, #{balance}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select ifnull((select balance from br_stock_ledger where material_id = #{materialId} order by id desc limit 1), 0)
select ifnull(sum(qty), 0) from br_stock_ledger where material_id = #{materialId} and goods_source_type = #{goodsSourceType} and goods_source_no = #{goodsSourceNo}

select l.*, m.material_name, m.material_cd, m.is_bonded, m.g_model, m.code_ts from br_stock_ledger l left join br_material m on m.id = l.material_id where l.biz_table = #{bizTable} and l.biz_id = #{bizId} order by l.id
